summary_en: The video features spectacular lion and dragon dance performances on high poles across outdoor and indoor stages. Performers in orange uniforms play traditional instruments such as large drums and cymbals, while a red lion costume executes balance maneuvers, complex movements, and experiences a fall onto safety mats under the observation of spectators and judges.
